chunks: The day the earth will split asunder they will come out hurriedly. This gathering together is easy for Us.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the earth on the Day of Resurrection according to Surah Qaf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the splitting of the earth (shaqqa) is viewed not merely as a physical event but as a sign of God's absolute power over creation, fulfilling the promise of resurrection. This verse underscores the ease with which Allah gathers all beings, contrasting the immense scale of the event with the divine capability, thereby reinforcing the certainty of the Hereafter for the believers.
